TCC Website 0.12.3: password-protected events stay private, and a safer Planning Center notice

From the code audit of 24 November 2026:
- A password-protected event no longer puts its words into its search
  description or link preview (event-search-text).
- Site search leaves out password-protected upcoming events, like other
  protected pages (sitewide-search).
- The search card's picture address is quoted inside its style.
- The Planning Center screen's message after a button is kept for a
  minute on the website instead of being read from the page address, so
  a link from someone else cannot show made-up words there.

New tests in tests/playground/tests/security-fixes.php; all 114 pass in
WordPress Playground.
